name: acl_attr_from_mode
notes: sets *attr from an SCE_S_* mode: kscePfsACSetFSAttrByMode (SceSblACMgrForDriver_6210D745)(pid, {cls, attr, 1}, mode), cls 2 for FAT16 mounts (flags 0x8000 without 0x1000), else 3. For privileged threads (access level 0x40/0x80): rw/rw 0x186 -> 0, 0x106 -> SYSTEM, 0x104 -> SYSTEM|RO, 0x6 -> SYSTEM|HIDDEN, 0x4 -> all three (0x10000 in mode picks RO instead of SYSTEM for 0x106); user threads (0x10/0x20): 0x180 -> 0, 0x100 -> RO; changing SYSTEM needs a privileged thread (0x8001000D); mode 0x1000000 -> 0x0F. Used by create/mkdir/chstat and the SceIoTrash directory (mode 6)

name: acl_inherit_attr
notes: SceSblACMgrForDriver_B12CEAA8 (acm_inherit_attr)(pid, {cls, attr, 1}, {cls, &parent_attr, 1}): *attr takes parent_attr's low 3 bits (RO/HIDDEN/SYSTEM); SYSTEM only for privileged threads

name: acl_attr_from_mode_level
proto: int acl_attr_from_mode_level(exfat_mnt *m, u32 mode, u32 level, u8 *attr)
notes: SceSblACMgrForDriver_0606B87E(mode, level, {cls, attr, 1}): the mode -> attribute mapping of acl_attr_from_mode for an explicit thread access level, exact mode match, unlisted -> 0x80010002 (mkdir_core uses level 0x80)

name: acl_check_read
notes: read-access check (req 1) of an entry attribute: SceSblACMgrForDriver_BE5667C5 (acm_check_access)(pid, {cls, &attr, 1}, 1). User threads may read anything but SYSTEM|HIDDEN (6/7); privileged threads everything; a denial is 0x8001000D. attr 0x0F (the LFN attribute value used as a special marker) is first passed through SceSblACMgrForDriver_48CFCEA2 (acm_clear_special_attr) with the mount ID (mnt_data+0x10): only lma0: (ID 0x10000) turns it into 0, any other mount returns 0x800F0916; m or mnt_data NULL -> 0x8001000E

name: acl_attr_to_mode
notes: returns the SCE_S_* mode of an attribute: same 0x0F handling as acl_check_read, then SceSblACMgrForDriver_3B356B98 (acm_get_mode): RO/SYSTEM bits -> {0x186, 0x106, 0x186, 0x106, 0x106, 0x104, 0x6, 0x4}[attr & 7]; errors are returned as negative values

name: acl_root_attr
notes: root directory attribute: SceSblACMgrForDriver_FF7125DE (acm_get_root_mode)(pid, assign_name +0xc0) gives a mode (sd0: 0x186, lma0: 0x1000000, the other known assigns 0x106), converted with kscePfsACSetFSAttrByMode; on success and unless it is 0x0F, DIRECTORY (0x10) is added. So the root is plain rw on sd0:, SYSTEM (user read-only) elsewhere for privileged callers, READONLY for user threads, 0x0F on lma0:

name: sjis_to_ucs2
proto: void sjis_to_ucs2(int cp, int lead, int trail, u8 *lo, u8 *hi)
notes: CP932->UCS-2 via JIS X0208 94x94 table @0x81015858; 0xA1-0xDF -> U+FF61..; lead 0x05 = escaped 0xE5; bad -> U+25A0

name: dbcs936_949_to_ucs2
proto: void (int cp, int lead, int trail, u8 *lo, u8 *hi)
notes: cp 0xE (GBK, 0x80->U+20AC, table @*0x8101d050) / 0xF (UHC, table @*0x8101d058); bad -> U+25A0

name: big5_to_ucs2
proto: void (int cp, int lead, int trail, u8 *lo, u8 *hi)
notes: cp 0x10 Big5, table @*0x8101d054 (0x9d trails/row)

name: ucs2_to_big5
proto: void (int cp, u8 lo, u8 hi, u8 *b0, u8 *b1)
notes: linear search of Big5 table; unmappable -> 0xA1BD

name: ucs2_to_sjis
proto: void (int cp, u8 lo, u8 hi, char *b0, u8 *b1)
notes: U+FF61..FF9F -> 0xA1..0xDF; linear search of the JIS X0208 table @0x81015858 (94x94), skipping rows 8-11 (except 12) and 88-91; row/col -> SJIS lead/trail; unmappable -> 0x81A1

name: sbcs_to_ucs2
proto: void (int cp, int c, int zero, u8 *lo, u8 *hi)
notes: (Ghidra decodes it as data; read from disassembly) cp 2..0x11 -> table ptr[cp-2] @0x8101b8b8 (128 u16 for 0x80..0xFF), else default table @0x8101b178; byte <0x80 passthrough; second byte must be 0; zero table entry or bad input -> U+25A0

name: ucs2_to_sbcs
proto: void (int cp, u8 lo, u8 hi, u8 *b0, u8 *b1)
notes: reverse search (128 entries) in table ptr[cp-2] @0x8101baf8 or default @0x8101b178; ASCII passthrough; unmappable -> 0x85 (cp 0xC), 0xBF (cp 0x11), else 0xFE

name: cp_tables_init
notes: codepage := 0xD (CP932, never changed on 3.65); allocates memblock "SceFatfsCPTable" (type 0x1020D006, 0xC000) and points the 3 DBCS table ptrs @0x8101d050/54/58 at it

name: cp_ucs2_to_oem
proto: int cp_ucs2_to_oem(char *dst, int dstlen, const u16 *src)
notes: dispatch by codepage (1-0xC,0x11 SBCS; 0xD SJIS; 0xE/0xF GBK/UHC; 0x10 Big5); returns bytes written

name: cp_oem_to_ucs2
proto: int cp_oem_to_ucs2(u16 *dst, int dstsize, const u8 *src)
notes: dispatch by the current codepage (0x8101d05c), TBB at 0x81000990 on cp-1: cp 1..12 and 17 -> sbcs_to_ucs2, 13 -> sjis_to_ucs2, 14/15 -> dbcs936_949_to_ucs2, 16 -> big5_to_ucs2 (cases 13 and 16 sit in the split fragment 0x81000b0e..0x81000b22, read from the disassembly); out of range -> EINVAL. A 2-byte sequence is taken when lead/trail are valid: SJIS lead 0x81-0x9F/0xE0-0xFC (or 0x05) trail 0x40-0x7E/0x80-0xFC; GBK lead 0x81-0xFE trail 0x40-0x7E/0x80-0xFE; UHC lead 0x81-0xFD trail A-Z/a-z/0x81-0xFE; Big5 lead 0xA1-0xF9 trail 0x40-0x7E/0xA1-0xFE; returns UTF-16 bytes written

name: cp_is_dbcs_pair
notes: same lead/trail rules as cp_oem_to_ucs2 (SBCS codepages -> false)

name: cp_ucs2_is_wide
notes: true if code point c takes 2 OEM bytes: SJIS: not 1..0x7E and not U+FF61..FF9F; GBK: not 1..0x7E, 0x80 or U+20AC; UHC/Big5: not 1..0x7E; SBCS: false
